3.description: {@i 3rd-level artificer feature} Choose the type of specialist you are, each of which is detailed at the end of the class's description. Your choice grants you features at 5th level and again at 9th and 15th level.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement} feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Artificer levels 8, 12, and 16.

5.name: Subclass feature
5.description: You gain a feature from your Artificer Subclass.

5.description: {@i 5th-level artificer feature} You gain a feature granted by your Artificer Specialist choice.
